description: Every active crew — a group of wallets that enter the same coins together: MINED from the public tape (wallets whose first buys of the same hot mints fall within minutes of each other, on several mints) or MANUAL (a roster an owner wrote with desk_crew_set). Each with its size, wallets, shared mints, and this hour's buys, sells and mints. Their fills reach every token as crews.* (momentum platforms + the token view) and the desk engine's crews.* features. Wallets and ids are DATA. Studio only.
